basis: `git diff origin/main...HEAD -- core/src/server/dashboard/index.html | git apply --reverse` reverts the branch's own changes to one dashboard HTML file, then runs status and diff --check. The marker is the opaque-writer closure: git apply is a writer whose target the gate cannot resolve from the text. But the target is fully determined by the pathspec in the same command (one non-governance file), and the effect is to restore main's version. Justified; this is the known opaque-writer false-positive shape.
